cards.card_text: What does God say will happen to anyone who mixes perfume like the sacred oil or puts it on an outsider?
cards.verse_text: Anyone who mixes perfume like it or puts it on an outsider shall be cut off from his people.’”
cards.snippet: Anyone who mixes perfume like it or puts it on an outsider shall be cut off…

cards.card_text: Naomi tells Ruth to wash, put on perfume and wear her best clothes.
cards.verse_text: Therefore wash yourself, put on perfume, and wear your best clothes.
cards.snippet: Therefore wash yourself, put on perfume, and wear your best clothes.

cards.card_text: They lay him on a bier full of spices and blended perfumes, and they make a great fire in his honor.

cards.snippet: …him on a bier that was full of spices and various blended perfumes; then they made a great fire in his honor.

cards.card_text: Before her turn with King Xerxes, each young woman gets twelve months of beauty treatments: six with oil of myrrh, then six with perfumes and cosmetics.
cards.verse_text: In the twelve months before her turn to go to King Xerxes, the harem regulation required each young woman to receive beauty treatments with oil of myrrh for six months, and then with perfumes and cosmetics for another six months.
cards.snippet: …beauty treatments with oil of myrrh for six months, and then with perfumes and cosmetics for another six months.

cards.card_text: Then she tells him she's decked her bed with colored linen from Egypt and perfumed it with myrrh, aloes and cinnamon.

cards.snippet: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, with aloes, and with cinnamon.

cards.card_text: In that day, the Lord will take away their finery, and Isaiah lists it out: anklets, headbands, perfume bottles, nose rings, festive robes, purses, mirrors and a whole lot more.
